verdict.rationale: WorkOS AuthKit documents built-in social sign-in ('Sign in to your app with Microsoft, Google, and more') bundled 'from one integration' with a hosted UI. Separately, its SSO service works with any SAML or OIDC IdP. However, only Microsoft and Google are named. The evidence never shows that social providers are switched on through dashboard configuration rather than code. One community report also notes a Slack OAuth option was missing from setup. missing for 10: a documented list showing a broad set of social providers, docs showing social providers are enabled through dashboard configuration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer sign-in with a broad set of social and OAuth identity providers through configuration, not custom code

citations.quote: Sign in to your app with Microsoft, Google, and more
AuthKit includes email + password, social login, passkeys, MFA, magic auth, and enterprise SSO — all from one integration.
This service is compatible with any IdP that supports either the SAML or OIDC protocols.
